data.body: Research summary: pydantic-settings documents env vars are parsed verbatim by default, including empty values, and offers an explicit env_ignore_empty option when callers want empty env vars ignored; pip documents environment variables override config files and warns empty strings are not equivalent to false (use no/false/0); Django deployment checks treat security-critical empty settings such as SECRET_KEY as invalid configuration. Decision applied: per-key policy, not blanket string coercion. Protection-direction keys with empty env overrides are faults; documented meaningful empty-env defaults remain accepted.
